name: Upright Loom
blurb: A tall timber frame strung with pale warp threads and a heavy weaving beam, the old way of making cloth.

era.note: A standing warp loom, plain cottage weaving gear. Original UO art that the original map never places (zero statics); the main catalog uses only the deed loom.

implNote: single tile (0x1063 south view, 0x1064 east view); decor-only, inert

name: Great Standing Loom
blurb: A master weaver's great loom, its shuttle-race and treadles worked into a frame of polished timber.

era.note: A large treadle loom, a weaving-hall fixture of any age. The art is a later addition to the client with no expansion theme.

implNote: single tile (0xA81D south view, 0xA82D east view); the other tiles of the family are animation frames, not used

name: Embroidery Hoop
blurb: A round hoop of cloth stretched taut, half-finished roses blooming across it in coloured thread.

era.note: A plain needlework hoop with a rose pattern. Embroidery is as old as cloth; the art is a later addition to the client with no expansion theme.

implNote: single tile; decor-only, inert

name: Pile of Cured Hides
blurb: Tawny hides cured and stacked flat, waiting on the tanner's table for the next order.

era.note: A stack of tanned hides, trade stock for any tanner or cobbler. The art is a later addition to the client with no expansion theme.

implNote: single tile (0x9BCE south, 0x9BCF east); decor-only, inert

name: Dark Iron Anvil
blurb: A black, many-times-struck anvil with a long horn, the kind a smith will not part with at any price.

era.note: A plain smithing anvil. Anvils are original UO equipment; the main catalog holds the older art, this is a second, darker drawing. The art is a later addition to the client with no expansion theme.

implNote: single tile (0xA108 south idle, 0xA102 east idle); the animated strike frames are not used

name: Forge Bellows
